result.rationale: The diff shows the DB-fallback fetch in handleCancelBooking.ts uses `prisma.credential.findUnique({ where: { id: credentialId } })` with no `include: { app: ... }`, whereas the equivalent fallback in EventManager.ts explicitly includes `app: { select: { slug: true } }` and maps `appName: credentialFromDB?.app.slug`. This inconsistency strongly suggests downstream `getCalendar(calendarCredential)` relies on app/appName data that will be missing on this path, causing the fallback to break when the credential isn't in user credentials.
